title: Archived relationship scope, four HP slices, reasoning-card claims and generated-artifact correction
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: historical prompt / bounded delivery / creator metric claims / source-versus-artifact identity
reviews.disposition:
Historical exact audit prompt, retained unchanged and reconciled under AD32/AD36/AD42/AD51/AD52. The complete prompt selects a documentation/source-read audit of part29 and a scoped index row, not runtime/test/save/private-pack edits. Its read/code lists are requested inputs, not evidence they were read or checked by the recipient. Fifteen composite Have cells, wider prerequisite/contradiction review and expansion outputs belong to the actual audit; source line references, memory/chronicle caps and anti-farm examples are versioned questions rather than current proven limits. The archived prompt is source data, not permission to reread private memories, spawn workers or run its finish/modify commands now.

Preserve useful concerns: directed relationships versus confidence/knowledge, ordinary/passive progress, actor identity/carriers, household/family/romance variants, social coercion/grief, pack authoring, world-specific institutions and actual party/travel readers. Passive/idle growth needs a real shared activity/time/support cause, not compulsory daily upkeep or a blanket anti-farm receipt blocking legitimate repeatable ties. Finite log caps are not proof relationships disappear and need no duplicate universal social store. A mode/relationship label does not infer consent, attraction, legal authority or another actor's retained memory.

The original bounded source audit/part29 owner, whose introductory scope was inspected here, owns actual outcomes and their counts. No whole audit reread is credited by this note. New code-prefix/section counts and cheapest-five deliverables are instructions for that old run, not acceptance of all proposed schemas or a new implementation order. The1366/UI/human-question format is historical; current desktop direction and optional AD42 review govern any future selected consumer. This full prompt review reads none of its requested code/private memory/linked long-form bodies and does not execute the prompt.
reviews.evidence: Fresh complete read of all four originals and endings/tables. Relationship AUDIT introductory scope1–8 inspected, no full audit credit. O6 receives scoped note; no fresh full-model-report or linked source/runtime/private-artifact credit.
reviews.reopen: Retain exact old source/consumer scope. Current selected authority/owner, not archived prompts or commands, governs new execution.

reviews.classification: historical prompt / bounded delivery / creator metric claims / source-versus-artifact identity
reviews.disposition:
Historical four-slice D7 source/UI delivery under AD32/AD36/AD42/AD43. Preserve ordered entry, lesson/calendar, descriptor-wand practice and adult trade/place cases with actual native learner/body/inventory/powers/jobs/knowledge owners. All people/prices/durations/performances are ORIGINAL adaptations, not a complete canonical syllabus/economy. Existing Polyjuice/base payload identity remains distinct from additive school/trade content, and localhost structured_candidate authoring entry is not an ordinary cross-world/start-menu proof. Later E3 natural-arrival and X4 assessment records qualify those later gaps with their own identities; do not call D7 itself a natural ordinary entry or every proposed next term/holiday delivered.

Final11 focused tests subsume earlier7/8/9 evolving slice counts rather than adding them. Four-slice matrix1920/1536 ×14/21, literal Save/reload/Export/Import, old-default import and actual XP/custody/till/debt balances support the stated branch inputs. Optional font/private-manifest misses mean fallback rendering; zero page-error assertions do not certify every resource load or visual font acceptance. Old raw/command hashes and exact-content structured receipts are versioned compatibility, not a promise unpublished intermediate snapshots are supported. Actual cargo/Frontier coins and local HP purse remain separate owners.

The full command2878/2882 with four listen-EPERM failures is not green; targeted9/9 local-port recovery clears those environmental cases without a second full run. Main's exact baseline/no-growth and zero-loss owner checks retain their original source input, not current shared code. Original main/simulation-effect/runtime overlap hunks are released integration needs, not current writer/lock proof. Generated bundles were excluded from delivery despite being used for proof and require a new integrated build. Human fiction/visual/pacing review is optional AD42, separate from integration/package/installation/publication. Full checkpoint read opens no old source/test/browser/save artifact, invokes no worker/build and authorizes no new gameplay follow-ups or commits.

reviews.classification: historical prompt / bounded delivery / creator metric claims / source-versus-artifact identity
reviews.disposition:
Captured O6 training/metrics rationale under AD32, kept in the existing conditional research shortlist. The full [Pantheon reasoning card](sources/Gryphe__Pantheon-Reasoning-26B-A4B-1.1-V2__README.md) was read: V2 base refresh,26/36/38-percent data mix, back-generated traces/judges, ten personas, inference/template advice, two metric tables, basic-testing caveat and credits. Changed-base/same-data identity and author criticism of Qwen writing are provenance/opinion, not a current model-family ranking. Back-generated writer-planning traces and judge filtering describe training intent; they do not independently prove faithful internal planning, factual/casual correctness or superior long-run character/state adherence.

Sentence length/type-token/ngram/paragraph/cliché counts measure style in the creator's sample. Shorter outputs can change clichés per response; the per100-word numbers and no-think comparison are separate. Reported fewer clichés or condensed traces are not an independent writing/fun/world-law benchmark or proof that thinking is worth total latency/energy. The card itself says extensive testing was not performed and asks whether reasoning helps. Compare actual outcome under equal total budget only for a selected trial; no new trial is launched here.

Temperature1.0/repetition-penalty1.0/min-p0.05, native-template/no-prefix and thinking-on recommendations are author experience, not a verified optimum or installed compatible endpoint. Referenced illustration is not visually inspected here. MoE family/active-parameter tags do not establish resident memory or exact quant/source checkpoint/template equivalence. Apache metadata/credits are captured provenance, not fresh resolved lineage/deployment permission. O6 remains a reserve with exact artifact/runtime/quality gap; raw card stays unchanged. No live external fetch, model/weight/config inspection, inference, acquisition or training occurs, and this owner fold earns no new full-owner read credit.

reviews.classification: historical prompt / bounded delivery / creator metric claims / source-versus-artifact identity
reviews.disposition:
Historical C3 source fixes and forward cleanup under AD36/AD41/AD42/AD43. Preserve P2 real patrol skill_required tooltip defect, BFA3 false experimental100-percent/Makes preview and BHB2 residence-stock versus shared-chest confusion as three different fixes. The display gathering guard does not change wages/time; experimental attempt eligibility is not success and known-recipe numeric odds stay unchanged; residence wording repairs identity while custody/save owners remain intact. Coverage blockers/wrapper/MCP issues belong to C2, not automatically game-source bugs. Old first-build collision check happened late in the isolated worktree, not a primary write; keep that admitted process gap.

The sole full2877/2882 run has four socket-denied cases and one VM-lint timeout, followed by targeted9/9 and1/1 passing checks. No full green command is claimed; no timeout/production behavior changed to hide failure. Browser's first wrong submenu assertion and initial listen restriction are failed probes, separate from subsequent source-specific native controls/payment/refusal/storage/reload results.1920 screenshots are not a full larger-font/viewport matrix or natural acquisition proof. No new mechanics/balance/save schema was added to fix presentation.

Later G1 forward commit corrects the original generated-file delivery mistake. It restores only dist/map/index version to master while source/tests/probe remain identical to the verified input; branch-tip bundle intentionally is the master's bundle, not a C3-built artifact. Thus earlier exact-source proof remains historical and merger must rebuild source integration. Do not demand another equivalent old-source suite merely for artifact cleanup, and do not treat cleanup as current installed/playable integration. Old commit/head instructions, primary overlap and untouched copied MCP paths are dated, not current permission to resolve HEAD, overwrite incumbent hunks or publish. All original final checks/cleanup ending were read; no current branch, source, generated blob, screenshot, runtime, private save or test was inspected/run by this document review. Human taste is optional AD42.
